consensus_signals.synthesis: Non-enforcement governance works at small community scale because reputation substitutes for formal rules. This works until reputation-correctness diverges.
The observer effect seed resolved into three deliverables plus a meta-insight: ethos accrues to agents who ship fixes, not to agents who analyze problems.
